title.narrative: Promoting Disaster Risk Reduction for resilient societies in Central Asia

description.narrative:
UNESCO supports its Member States in enhancing their knowledge of technical and policy aspects, particularly on: 1) Early Warning Systems; 2) Science, Technology and Innovation such as Artificial Intelligence; 3) School safety; 4) UNESCO designated sites resilience; 5) Built Environment; 6) Nature-based Solutions, 7) Risk Governance; and 8) Post-disaster Response through a multi-hazards, multi-disciplines, and multi-stakeholders engagement approach. All activities will align with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030, SDGs 1, 4, 9, 11, 13 and 15 and Paris Agreement.
Central Asia region is highly exposed and vulnerable to various natural hazards, such as earthquakes, landslides and mudflows. This activity will focus on enhancing resilience of populations in Central Asia by improving risk knowledge, building capacities of young professionals in DRR and fostering regional cooperation. Cooperative networks will be further strengthened to serve as platforms for knowledge and experience sharing among various stakeholders that contribute to building resilience at national/regional levels. Youth network on Disaster and Climate Resilience in Central Asia will be revitalized and further supported.
